principles: Parent governance DONE is not full roadmap completion
Layer on B-5082 rather than replacing ProofStory
Local CLI assurance only; no server-backed Authority semantics
drivers: The user asked to implement the B-9fc5 plan until DONE
M1 must be Red/Repro before full implementation
The product needs an operator-visible parent roadmap state
The existing parent_ledger_rollup model is too narrow for allRowsClosed and claim boundaries

options.name: A: Add parent-roadmap totality module plus CLI/status and summary claim guard
pros: Can satisfy all M1-M8 in one end-to-end story
Avoids rewriting the existing ProofStory child coverage model
cons: Adds a new local concept and command surface that must be registered and documented

options.name: B: Extend existing parent_ledger_rollup_set in ProofStory only
pros: Reuses existing command names and storage path
cons: Mixes child coverage rollup with full roadmap completion semantics
Risks breaking existing B-5082 gates and older ProofStory records

options.name: C: Only enforce summary wording without new model
cons: Cannot prove allRowsClosed or row-level closure reasons
Would repeat the prior prose-over-evidence problem

chosen: A: Add parent-roadmap totality module plus CLI/status and summary claim guard
rationale: A provides a pure evaluator, explicit state vocabulary, CLI projection, and claim consumer while keeping B-5082 local-intent gates intact. It also lets M1 red tests prove the exact overclaim failure before runtime changes.

preMortem.scenario: Runtime work starts before red tests
preMortem.trigger: A code module lands before a failing/negative parent-roadmap smoke exists
preMortem.consequence: The story repeats the process failure the user called out
preMortem.mitigation: Make CHK-001 the first implementation item and commit the red/negative smoke before state/evaluator implementation.

preMortem.scenario: Partial parent DONE is blocked entirely
preMortem.trigger: The claim consumer treats allRowsClosed=false as lifecycle failure instead of wording/claim boundary
preMortem.consequence: Valid governance stories cannot close even when they honestly say partial_parent_done
preMortem.mitigation: Model claimType separately: partial_parent_done is allowed, full-roadmap wording is blocked.

preMortem.trigger: Parent-roadmap semantics are merged into parent_ledger_rollup_set incompatibly
preMortem.consequence: B-5082 local-intent hardening breaks or old records become unreadable
preMortem.mitigation: Use a separate parent-roadmap totality module and compatibility projection; only add integrations through stable adapters.

preMortem.scenario: Historical roadmaps are silently marked complete
preMortem.trigger: Migration defaults missing rows to closed or not_applicable
preMortem.consequence: The exact overclaim bug returns for old parent stories
preMortem.mitigation: Default unknown historical parent rows to migration-needed or partial, never full complete without evidence.
